pois.name: Mi Teleférico Cable Car Network
pois.address: Estación Central, Avenida Manco Kapac, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: Soar above the Andean valley on the world's highest and longest urban cable car transit network, enjoying panoramic views of Mount Illimani.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Scenic eco-friendly urban transit with 360° Andean vistas
pois.tip: Ride the Red and Yellow lines for unforgettable mountain panoramas.

provenance.price_source: Municipal Transit Fare Authority (3 BOB per line)

pois.name: Mercado de las Brujas (Witches' Market)
pois.address: Calle Linares & Sagarnaga, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: Immerse in indigenous Aymara traditions, folk medicines, dried medicinal herbs, and handwoven Andean textiles.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Authentic local Andean cultural heritage and artisan shopping
pois.tip: Ask respectfully before photographing traditional healers and artisan stalls.

pois.name: Calle Jaén Colonial Quarter & Municipal Museums
pois.address: Calle Jaén, Casco Urbano Central, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: Stroll through La Paz's best-preserved cobblestone colonial street, housing four municipal museums including the Museum of Precious Metals.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Prioritized Hidden Gem: Quiet historic quarter rich in folklore and colonial architecture
pois.tip: A single ticket grants entry to all four municipal museums on Calle Jaén.

provenance.price_source: La Paz Municipal Culture Directorate (20 BOB combined ticket)

pois.name: Mirador Killi Killi Sunset Viewpoint
pois.address: Avenida Manuel Loza, Villa Pabón, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: Hilltop lookout providing a 360-degree vantage point across the dramatic canyon city of La Paz and snow-capped Mount Illimani at golden hour.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Prioritized Hidden Gem: Spectacular panoramic viewpoint away from heavy tour buses
pois.tip: Arrive between 17:45 and 18:30 to watch the Andean sunset bathe Mount Illimani in crimson light.

pois.name: Valle de la Luna (Moon Valley)
pois.description: Walk along canyon paths flanked by towering sandstone clay spires sculpted over millennia by wind and rain, just 10km south of central La Paz.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Surreal lunar landscape just 10km from central La Paz
pois.tip: Wear sturdy walking shoes with good grip on loose gravel paths.

provenance.price_source: Municipal Parks Administration (15 BOB entry fee)

pois.name: Tiwanaku Archaeological Sanctuary & Kalasasaya Temple
pois.description: Explore the UNESCO World Heritage pre-Columbian spiritual complex, featuring the monolithic Sun Gate (Puerta del Sol) and Kalasasaya Temple.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Ancient heritage site of one of South America's greatest civilizations
pois.tip: Includes entry to both the outdoor ceremonial grounds and the ceramic museum.

provenance.price_source: UNESCO / Bolivian Archaeological Directorate (100 BOB ticket)

pois.name: Lake Titicaca & Copacabana White-Sand Lakeside Beach
pois.address: Avenida Costanera, Copacabana, Lake Titicaca, Bolivia
pois.description: Explore the tranquil white-sand lakeside beach, azure waters, and sacred Inca boat crossings of Lake Titicaca at Copacabana. Bolivia is a landlocked nation without ocean coastlines, making the pristine waters of Lake Titicaca its premier freshwater beach experience.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Truthful landlocked water and beach alternative: Lake Titicaca Copacabana shores
pois.tip: Walk along the lakefront promenade to watch local wooden sail boats and colorful catamarans.
nearby: Basilica of Our Lady of Copacabana

pois.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Copacabana
pois.description: 16th-century Moorish-style pilgrimage basilica housing the revered carved wooden statue of the Virgin of Copacabana, the patroness of Bolivia.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Historic architectural gem and sacred spiritual center on Lake Titicaca
pois.tip: Visit the cloister museum to see rare colonial religious paintings and silver ex-votos.

pois.name: Cerro Calvario Sunset Viewpoint
pois.description: Scenic stone pilgrim trail climbing 30 minutes up a prominent hill overlooking the sweeping crescent bay of Copacabana and sunset over Lake Titicaca.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Spectacular sunset panorama over sacred Lake Titicaca
pois.tip: Start the climb around 17:30 to reach the summit for the 18:35 golden hour and sunset.

pois.name: Isla del Sol (Sun Island) & Pilkokaina Inca Palace
pois.address: Yumani & Pilkokaina, Isla del Sol, Lake Titicaca, Bolivia
pois.description: Legendary birthplace of the Inca sun god Inti. Walk along ancient stone paths to the two-story stone Temple of Pilkokaina and the Fountain of Eternal Youth.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Mythical Inca cradle surrounded by the sparkling azure waters of Lake Titicaca
pois.tip: Take the morning public ferry from Copacabana harbor at 08:30 AM (approx. 90 mins).

provenance.price_source: Yumani Indigenous Community Tourism Fee (30 BOB)

pois.name: Museo Nacional de Etnografía y Folklore (MUSEF)
pois.address: Calle Ingavi 916, Casco Urbano Central, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: Bolivia's premier cultural museum showcasing remarkable collections of ceremonial feathered art, indigenous masks, traditional textiles, and Andean ceramics.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ World-class ethnographic museum in an elegant 18th-century marquis palace
pois.tip: Do not miss the permanent 'Masks of Bolivia' exhibition in the lower vaulted gallery.

provenance.price_source: National Cultural Foundation of the Central Bank of Bolivia (30 BOB)

pois.name: Plaza Murillo & Historic Colonial Walking Quarter
pois.address: Plaza Murillo, Casco Urbano Central, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: The political heart of Bolivia, surrounded by the neoclassical National Congress building, the Presidential Palace (Palacio Quemado), and the Cathedral Basilica.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Historic civic square featuring grand republican and colonial facades
pois.tip: Observe the unique counter-clockwise clock on the National Congress building facade.
nearby: Catedral Basílica de Nuestra Señora de La Paz

pois.name: Popular Cocina Boliviana
pois.address: Calle Murillo 1015, Casco Urbano Central, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: Celebrated contemporary Bolivian kitchen serving daily gourmet 3-course menus that reinterpret traditional Andean recipes with vegetarian options.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Acclaimed authentic Andean lunch venue with dedicated vegetarian selections
pois.tip: Arrive at 12:15 PM as seats fill quickly for their daily seasonal menu.
pois.signature_dish: Sopa de Maní Vegetariana (Creamy Bolivian peanut soup prepared with vegetable broth, native Andean tubers, peas, and crispy shoestring potatoes)
pois.dish_ingredients: Toasted ground peanuts, vegetable broth, freeze-dried chuño potato, cumin, peas, shoestring potatoes (100% vegetarian, no meat stock)

provenance.dietary_verification: Verified vegetarian menu option (vegetable broth confirmed)
provenance.opening_hours_source: Published Restaurant Lunch Hours (12:30 PM - 3:30 PM)

pois.name: Ali Pacha
pois.address: Calle Colón 357, Casco Urbano Central, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: World-renowned 100% plant-based fine dining restaurant celebrating native Bolivian biodiversity through innovative tasting courses.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Latin America Top 50 discovery restaurant: 100% dedicated vegetarian and vegan fine dining
pois.tip: Try their seasonal tasting menu pairing native tubers, Amazonian fruits, and highland grains.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Degustación Andina de Quinua y Tubérculos
pois.signature_dish: Degustación Andina (Native Royal Quinoa, Roasted Amazonian Heart of Palm, Smoked Andean Potatoes & Wild Cocoa Puree)
pois.dish_ingredients: Organic royal quinoa, native oca, hearts of palm, Bolivian cocoa, mountain herbs (100% certified plant-based)

provenance.opening_hours_source: Official Ali Pacha Dinner Hours (7:00 PM - 10:30 PM)

pois.name: Cafe del Mundo
pois.description: Charming traveler hub on Calle Sagárnaga offering fresh vegetarian wraps, homemade Andean sweet corn humintas, and organic Los Yungas coffee.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Popular cozy cafe with extensive vegetarian, vegan, and breakfast choices
pois.tip: Order the freshly steamed sweet corn huminta with a cup of hot spiced api.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Humintas de Choclo al Horno con Café de Los Yungas
pois.signature_dish: Humintas de Choclo (Steamed sweet Andean corn tamales with fresh farmer's cheese, anise, and hot coffee)
pois.dish_ingredients: Fresh ground choclo corn, queso criollo (pasteurized fresh cheese), anise, butter, cane sugar

provenance.price_source: A la carte menu average (45 BOB)
provenance.opening_hours_source: Published Daily Cafe Hours (8:00 AM - 9:30 PM)

pois.name: Namas Te Vegetarian Teahouse
pois.address: Calle Zoilo Flores 1334, San Pedro, La Paz, Bolivia
pois.description: Peaceful vegetarian oasis in the San Pedro district serving wholesome organic lunches, Andean grain bowls, and loose-leaf herbal teas.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ 100% vegetarian sanctuary with hearty homemade daily menus
pois.tip: Their set lunch includes an organic soup, vegetable main, and freshly brewed herbal infusion.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Plato Completo Vegetariano de Quinua y Hortalizas
pois.signature_dish: Almuerzo Completo Vegetariano (Quinoa vegetable stew, fresh avocado salad, and organic muña herbal tea)
pois.dish_ingredients: Royal quinoa, seasonal squash, carrots, lentils, native potatoes, fresh salad (100% vegetarian)

pois.name: La Cupula Restaurant & Sunset Terrace
pois.address: Calle Michel Pérez 1-3, Cerro Calvario, Copacabana, Bolivia
pois.description: Perched on the lower slopes of Cerro Calvario with panoramic views of Lake Titicaca, renowned for baked corn casseroles, cheese fondue, and Andean soups.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Spectacular sunset lake vistas paired with delicious vegetarian-friendly dining
pois.tip: Reserve a table by the panoramic window for twilight views across the lake.
pois.signature_dish: Pastel de Choclo (Sweet-savory baked Andean corn casserole with melted farmer's cheese, raisins, and mild spices)
pois.dish_ingredients: Fresh Andean choclo corn, artisanal cheese, eggs, raisins, sweet onion (Vegetarian preparation)

provenance.price_source: Evening Dinner A la carte average (70 BOB)
provenance.opening_hours_source: Published Restaurant Dinner Hours (6:00 PM - 10:00 PM)

pois.name: Restaurant El Cóndor & The White Cat
pois.description: Friendly travelers' cafe on Copacabana's main avenue featuring stir-fried royal quinoa, hearty vegetable soups, and local fruit smoothies.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Casual welcoming cafe with healthy vegetarian lunch bowls
pois.tip: Enjoy a fresh papaya-orange smoothie along with your quinoa vegetable bowl.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Quinua al Wok con Verduras Andinas
pois.signature_dish: Quinua al Wok con Verduras Andinas (Stir-fried royal quinoa with seasonal vegetables, avocado, and toasted sesame)
pois.dish_ingredients: Royal quinoa, bell peppers, zucchini, carrots, avocado, soy sauce, lime (100% vegetarian)

pois.name: Taipi Uta Tiwanaku Cultural Dining
pois.address: Avenida Manco Kapac, Tiwanaku Village, Bolivia
pois.description: Traditional Andean dining hall located just outside the Tiwanaku sanctuary gates, serving hearty vegetarian grain plates to travelers.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Convenient authentic lunch stop right by the archaeological sanctuary
pois.tip: Order the Plato Andino with broad beans and native potatoes.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Plato Andino de Quinua Real y Habas
pois.signature_dish: Plato Andino de Quinua Real (Steamed royal quinoa with native potatoes, Andean broad beans, and grilled cheese)
pois.dish_ingredients: Organic royal quinoa, native boiled potatoes, tender habas (broad beans), pan-seared cheese (No meat)
